official_faction_pack.title: Chaos Daemons Faction Pack
official_faction_pack.verified: The 2 CP reaction follows an enemy's completed Fall Back in the opponent's Movement phase. The unengaged friendly Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit must be within 6 inches of that enemy. Its Charge targets are enemy units that Fell Back in that phase and are within the Charge maximum. This printing does not withhold a Charge bonus.

faction_mirror.verified: The mirror shows the same eligibility, timing and target pool without a Charge bonus exception.

official_core.verified: Core Charge targets must also be within 12 inches. A completed Charge Move grants Fights First until the end of the current turn. Fight ordering resolves the Fights First band before remaining combats.

current_commentary.authority: Warhammer 40,000 App FAQ and Rules Appendix, checked in public transcriptions
current_commentary.verified: A Charge outside the Charge phase still rolls and attempts the Charge (11.02 steps 2 and 3). Out-of-phase rules exclude other expressly phase-locked rules, not the intrinsic Charge Move result.

acceptance: Resolve the ordinary Charge Move and Fights First grant on success; expire that grant at the end of the opponent's current turn. Do not import the older card's explicit exception.
